_comment: OPTIONAL. Orchestrator session only (the Claude session that ran /set-orchestrator on). Merge ONLY the "hooks" object into that session's settings.json (e.g. $CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR/settings.json) and replace <SKILL_DIR> with the absolute path of the set-orchestrator skill directory. Delete this _comment key when copying. After /compact or a resume, the hook prints a short reminder that this session is the orchestrator, but only while the Run's state file exists; with no state file it prints nothing. The matcher is a regex over the SessionStart source.
